question: Did the agent build the conversation with Genkit's agents API (an agent defined with a session store, such as `define_agent` in Python or `genkitx.DefineAgent` in Go) rather than a hand-rolled loop over `generate` calls that stores the history itself?

state.task:
Build a customer support Genkit agent in this directory, as a Go module with `package main` in the project root. It answers customers' questions about their orders with Gemini and has a tool that looks an order up by id; `orders.json` in this directory maps each order id to its `status` and `eta`. The Gemini API key is in the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.
The agent keeps a persistent session per customer, so that a conversation continues after the process restarts. Expose this in `package main`:
`func Ask(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, message string) (reply string, newSessionID string, err error)`
An empty `sessionID` starts a new conversation; an id that an earlier call returned continues that conversation, even from a new process. `Ask` sets up everything it needs itself. `main` may chat with the agent however you like.

+package main
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"sync"
+
+	"github.com/firebase/genkit/go/ai"
+	aix "github.com/firebase/genkit/go/ai/exp"
+	"github.com/firebase/genkit/go/ai/exp/localstore"
+	"github.com/firebase/genkit/go/genkit"
+	genkitx "github.com/firebase/genkit/go/genkit/exp"
+	"github.com/firebase/genkit/go/plugins/googlegenai"
+)
+
+const ordersFile = "orders.json"
+const snapshotsDir = "./.snapshots"
+
+type orderLookupInput struct {
+	OrderID string `json:"orderId" jsonschema:"description=The customer's order id, e.g. A-7731"`
+}
+
+type orderLookupOutput struct {
+	Status string `json:"status" jsonschema:"description=Current status of the order"`
+	ETA    string `json:"eta" jsonschema:"description=Estimated delivery date"`
+}
+
+var (
+	initOnce   sync.Once
+	initErr    error
+	supportAgent *aix.Agent[any]
+)
+
+func initAgent(ctx context.Context) error {
+	initOnce.Do(func() {
+		g := genkit.Init(ctx,
+			genkit.WithExperimental(),
+			genkit.WithPlugins(&googlegenai.GoogleAI{}),
+		)
+
+		lookupOrder := genkit.DefineTool(g, "lookupOrder",
+			"Look up a customer's order by its order id, returning its status and estimated delivery date.",
+			func(tc *ai.ToolContext, in orderLookupInput) (orderLookupOutput, error) {
+				orders, err := loadOrders(ordersFile)
+				if err != nil {
+					return orderLookupOutput{}, err
+				}
+				order, ok := orders[in.OrderID]
+				if !ok {
+					return orderLookupOutput{}, fmt.Errorf("no order found with id %q", in.OrderID)
+				}
+				return orderLookupOutput{Status: order.Status, ETA: order.ETA}, nil
+			},
+		)
+
+		store, err := localstore.NewFileSessionStore[any](snapshotsDir)
+		if err != nil {
+			initErr = fmt.Errorf("creating session store: %w", err)
+			return
+		}
+
+		supportAgent = genkitx.DefineAgent(g, "supportAgent",
+			aix.InlinePrompt{
+				ai.WithModelName("googleai/gemini-flash-latest"),
+				ai.WithSystem("You are a friendly customer support agent. Customers will ask about "+
+					"the status of their orders. Use the lookupOrder tool to look up an order by id "+
+					"before answering. If the customer hasn't given an order id, ask for it. Keep "+
+					"answers brief and helpful."),
+				ai.WithTools(lookupOrder),
+			},
+			aix.WithSessionStore(store),
+		)
+	})
+	return initErr
+}
+
+// Ask sends a customer's message to the support agent and returns its reply.
+// Pass an empty sessionID to start a new conversation; pass a sessionID
+// returned from a previous call (even in an earlier process) to continue it.
+func Ask(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, message string) (reply string, newSessionID string, err error) {
+	if err := initAgent(ctx); err != nil {
+		return "", "", err
+	}
+
+	var out *aix.AgentOutput[any]
+	if sessionID == "" {
+		out, err = supportAgent.RunText(ctx, message)
+	} else {
+		out, err = supportAgent.RunText(ctx, message, aix.WithSessionID[any](sessionID))
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", err
+	}
+	if out.FinishReason == aix.AgentFinishReasonFailed {
+		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("agent turn failed: %v", out.Error)
+	}
+
+	return out.Message.Text(), out.SessionID, nil
+}

+package main
+
+import (
+	"bufio"
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+func main() {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+
+	fmt.Println("Customer support agent. Type your order questions, Ctrl-D to quit.")
+	fmt.Print("Session id to resume (blank for a new conversation): ")
+
+	reader := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
+	sessionID, _ := reader.ReadString('\n')
+	sessionID = strings.TrimSpace(sessionID)
+	if sessionID != "" {
+		fmt.Printf("Resuming session %s\n", sessionID)
+	}
+
+	for {
+		fmt.Print("you> ")
+		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
+		if err != nil {
+			break
+		}
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if line == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+
+		reply, newSessionID, err := Ask(ctx, sessionID, line)
+		if err != nil {
+			fmt.Println("error:", err)
+			continue
+		}
+		sessionID = newSessionID
+		fmt.Printf("agent> %s\n", reply)
+		fmt.Printf("(session id: %s)\n", sessionID)
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+)
+
+type Order struct {
+	Status string `json:"status"`
+	ETA    string `json:"eta"`
+}
+
+func loadOrders(path string) (map[string]Order, error) {
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading orders file: %w", err)
+	}
+	var orders map[string]Order
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &orders); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing orders file: %w", err)
+	}
+	return orders, nil
+}
